Interestingly, the LXX translators rendered this word as ἀναγινώσκω ('to read') and φωνή ('voice') in various contexts, which strongly suggests those Greek renderings reflect scribal name confusion rather than the animal term — pointing to a different lemma sharing this form in the narrative books of Kings, Chronicles, and Jeremiah.
